# Support

## Getting Help

Read the [README](../README.md) first: it documents every command, the global
flags, the configuration file, and the exit codes. `jira <command> --help`
prints the same detail for a single command.

Then choose by what you have:

| You have | Go to |
|---|---|
| A bug, with steps to reproduce | [Open a bug report](https://github.com/endgame-build/jira-cli/issues/new?template=bug_report.yml) |
| A feature idea | [Open a feature request](https://github.com/endgame-build/jira-cli/issues/new?template=feature_request.yml) |
| A security vulnerability | [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md), never a public issue |
| A question about using the CLI | [Search the issues](https://github.com/endgame-build/jira-cli/issues?q=is%3Aissue), then open one |

Include the output of `jira meta version` in anything you file.

## What This Project Covers

jira-cli talks to the Jira Cloud REST API v3. Questions about Jira itself,
about JQL syntax, or about your instance's configuration belong in the
[Atlassian Community](https://community.atlassian.com), which will answer them
faster than this issue tracker.

Jira Server and Jira Data Center are unsupported.

## Response Times

jira-cli is maintained by ENDGAME alongside client work. Issues get a first
response within about a week. Security reports move faster; see
[SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md).
